title: Budget Concerns & Perceived Cost Barrier
triggerPhrases: Your solution is outside our allocated budget this quarter
We cannot justify additional tooling spend right now
It seems expensive compared to using free Markdown files or basic wikis
rootCause: The prospect has not calculated the hidden cost of context-switching and developer time lost to copilot hallucinations and fragmented documentation.
pivotScript: I completely understand that budget scrutiny is strict right now. Let me ask: how much developer time was spent last month refactoring hallucinated AI code or tracking down outdated API specs?
counterArguments: A 50-person engineering team loses an estimated 200 hours per month navigating stale docs—exceeding $20,000/month in wasted engineering capacity.
Open-source core architecture eliminates per-seat extortion fees and gives complete data ownership.
Payback period is achieved in under 3 weeks through accelerated PR reviews and reduced onboarding lag.
proofPoints: Fintech Scale case study: reduced engineering onboarding time from 90 days to 28 days.
Zero data-egress penalty; operates directly on local git repositories.
suggestedNextStep: Schedule a 20-minute ROI review walking through the engineering velocity calculator.
